bio.text: Kelly Skidmore is a Democratic member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 92 and the House Minority Policy Chair for 2024 to 2026.

According to the House's biographical page, Skidmore was elected in 2020, also served in the House from 2006 to 2010, and was a legislative assistant in the Florida House and Senate from 1996 to 2005.
Skidmore lives in Boca Raton, is a chief executive officer, holds an A.A. from Palm Beach State College, lists the University of Florida (1981) under education, and was born in Cleveland, Ohio.
